hero.subheadline: I am thrilled about the opportunity at AssetWatch. The remote work culture aligns perfectly with my lifestyle, and this role promises to push my skills to new heights in sales development.

whyCompany.title: Building modern solutions in manufacturing
whyCompany.body: AssetWatch's innovative approach to simplifying manufacturing processes with cutting-edge solutions is truly inspiring. I admire the company's commitment to solving complex industry challenges.

whyCompany.title: Growth-focused hiring phase
whyCompany.body: AssetWatch is expanding its team at a crucial stage of growth, offering opportunities to significantly impact business expansion. This aligns well with my ambition to join a forward-thinking company poised for rapid progress.

whyCompany.title: Experience in B2B outreach
whyCompany.body: My BDR role at Copygen.ai honed my skills in lead generation and prospect engagement, crucial for success in AssetWatch's sales-driven environment. Experience from B2B outreach at NextAfter adds a valuable layer to my capabilities.

quote: I am driven by the potential to innovate sales strategies and contribute to AssetWatch's growth. The chance to leverage my skills in this role excites me deeply.
